longForm.heroHook: Turnkey by design. Validated for pharma before it ever ships.
longForm.heroLead: Integrating a homogenizer into a regulated production line usually means months of engineering, piping, and validation work before it ever runs a real batch. Pharma Skid removes that entire step, arriving as a complete, autonomous turnkey system built specifically for pharmaceutical and biotech production at industrial scale. Every skid handles pressures up to 1500 bar, delivering effective particle size reduction with maximum efficiency across cell rupture, nanoparticle, and nanoemulsion production, all while cutting energy use compared to other cell disruption systems. Built around the Ariete Series homogenizer core, each skid ships with a feed pump, by-pass system, and electrical power board as standard, ready to drop into an aseptic, cGMP and GAMP5-validated process line.

body.text: Pharma Skid is an autonomous, turnkey system customized to specific production requirements, processing a wide range of applications up to a maximum pressure of 1500 bar.
Particle size reduction runs with maximum efficiency and optimal yield across cell rupture, nanoparticle, and nanoemulsion production, with meaningful energy savings built in.
The standard configuration includes a feed pump with by-pass system, the homogenizer itself, and an electrical power board, ready to connect into an existing production line.
A long list of options extends the base skid further: heat exchanger, dust release control system, and instrumentation for flow rate, temperature, conductivity, and turbidity measurement.
Skids are available across different sizes of the Ariete Series homogenizer range, matching capacity to the specific production requirement.
Aseptic operating conditions are supported, and every skid complies with pharmaceutical regulations, following cGMP and GAMP5 validation standards.
Beyond pharmaceutical and biotechnology, the same platform extends naturally into pharma food and nutraceutical applications.
Continuous or batch (collective) processing modes are both supported, including nanoemulsion and nanodispersion production with notable energy savings versus other cell disruption systems.

body: Piecing together a feed pump, homogenizer, and power supply as separate installations is where most homogenization projects lose weeks. Pharma Skid arrives already integrated as one autonomous system.

The standard build, feed pump with by-pass, homogenizer, and electrical power board, covers the core requirement out of the box, while a long options list extends it for specific needs: heat exchangers for temperature-sensitive products, dust release control for containment-critical environments, and instrumentation for flow rate, temperature, conductivity, and turbidity.

Because the skid is built around the proven Ariete Series homogenizer core, available across multiple sizes, capacity scales to the actual production requirement rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all installation.
sections.note: Share the target production line's existing infrastructure and any temperature or containment requirements, and the right skid configuration and options list gets confirmed against it.

sections.title: Built for Regulated Production
sections.tabSummary: What cGMP and GAMP5 validation covers

items: Pharmaceutical and biotech production can't run on equipment that gets validated after installation. Pharma Skid ships already built to cGMP and GAMP5 standards, compliant with pharmaceutical regulations from the outset.
Aseptic operating conditions are supported directly, addressing sterile processing requirements without a separate retrofit.
That same validated design extends naturally into pharma food and nutraceutical applications, sectors that share much of the same regulatory rigor without being strictly pharmaceutical.
The result on the finished product reflects that rigor too: high efficiency and excellent performance in particle reduction, not just regulatory compliance for its own sake.
